quests.title: Anomaly: Liyue

dialogue.section: Check out the situation at The Chasm

dialogue.t: It's been a while since I saw you two.
You came to The Chasm too, huh? Looks like Liyue's taking the situation with these nails pretty seriously too.
Yes, both the adepti and the humans are very concerned about this unusual change.
Additional Millelith have been deployed to support the patrols around The Chasm, while Cloud Retainer and the other adepti have begun investigating the phenomenon.
What about you, then? What are you doing here?
Rex Lapis tasked me with monitoring this place. I travel swiftly, so I can notify him immediately of any further unusual activity.
Oh, Paimon figured he probably wouldn't be able to ignore this...

quests.description: Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.
